data.narrative:
New Limit, a Series C biotech & health company, is valued at $3.1B post-money on $610M+ in cumulative capital raised. The analysis triangulates valuation across a comp universe of 3 public equities (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Two applicable methods were deployed. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $3.1B last post-money valuation, implying $5.3B at the next funding stage. Peer-median valuation across three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables—Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M Series B)—yields a median of $3.8B. Public-comp anchoring was inapplicable due to absence of revenue disclosure for the target. The peer range spans $539M to $10.3B, reflecting meaningful dispersion within the early-stage biotech cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $3.2B (low) to $6.1B (high), with a median of $4.5B. The current $3.1B post-money sits at the low end of this range. Key uncertainties include stage-specific capital requirements, comparative clinical/technical progress versus peers, and investor appetite in biotech funding markets.
